verses.pali: Yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṁ na kukkuccāyati, yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṁ kukkuccāyati.
verses.english: One who isn’t remorseful over something they shouldn’t be, and one who is remorseful over something they should be.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā na vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements don’t grow.”
